description: [Ancien] Disponibilité en temps réel des places et des vélos dans les stations vélos en libre-service Naolib de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by JCDecaux. Disponibilités des vélos en libre-service de Nantes Métropole Ce jeu de données sera bientôt dépublié. Nous vous invitons à consulter le jeu de données suivant: Disponibilité temps réel des vélos libre-service Naolib de Nantes Métropole Le jeu de données fournit la disponibilité des vélos en libre-service Naolib de Nantes Métropole. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are stationnement, vélo, transport partagé, bicloo, Naolib, Temps réel. The portal shows 129 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
